T: Real witches hate children. They love soup.
D: A boy and his grandmother stumble onto a witches' convention at a seaside hotel in England.
P: Serve dessert when Bruno is told to eat the whole cake.
S: afternoon tea at the seaside hotel
Crustless sandwiches of cucumber and cream cheese, egg and cress, and smoked salmon with dill, cut into fingers and laid on a tiered stand.
the Cornish hotel where the convention meets

Soft white finger sandwiches of fresh crab in lemony mayonnaise with crisp cucumber and chives, crusts off, the way a seaside hotel does them. Mix 250g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, the zest of 1 lemon, a squeeze of juice, chopped chives and pepper. Butter 8 slices soft white bread with 30g butter. Spread the crab over 4 slices, lay thin slices of 1 Lebanese cucumber on top and close with the remaining bread. Press gently, trim off the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers.

Salmon cured for two days in salt, sugar, dill and white pepper, sliced paper thin onto rye with a sweet mustard and dill sauce. Mix 60g salt, 60g sugar and 1 tsp crushed white pepper. Lay a 600g skin-on salmon fillet in a dish, cover with the cure and a big bunch of chopped dill, wrap tightly and weigh down. Refrigerate 48 hours, turning every 12 hours. Scrape off the cure and slice very thin. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp vinegar, 60ml oil and chopped dill. Serve on 8 slices rye bread.
M: the green soup in the hotel dining room, formula-free
Leeks and potato sweated in butter, chicken stock added and simmered 20 minutes, watercress stirred in for 1 minute, blitzed bright green, finished with cream.
the hotel's on the Cornish coast

Flathead in a crisp soda water batter with double-fried chips, minty mushy peas, tartare sauce and lemon, wrapped in paper like the seaside shops. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then at 190C for 3 minutes. Simmer 400g frozen peas with 30g butter and mint for 5 minutes and mash roughly. Whisk 200g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and salt with 300ml cold soda water. Dust 4 flathead fillets in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 150g mayonnaise with gherkins, capers and lemon. Serve with lemon wedges.
W: the whole cake, in front of everyone
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour and cocoa folded in, baked at 170C for 40 minutes, covered in a thick dark ganache. Serve in thin slices.
K: afternoon tea in the hotel lounge

English breakfast tea brewed strong, sweetened with honey and blended with ripe peach, chilled and poured over ice with lemon and mint. Steep 4 English breakfast tea bags in 800ml boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and stir in 3 tbsp honey. Cool. Blend 2 ripe peaches (or 400g tinned peaches, drained) with 200ml cold water and strain into the tea. Chill 2 hours. Pour over ice in 4 tall glasses with lemon slices and a sprig of mint.

s.note: afternoon tea at the seaside hotel
s.how: Boil 3 eggs and mash with mayo and cress. Make sandwiches of cucumber with 100g cream cheese, the egg, and 100g smoked salmon with dill, using 12 slices white bread. Cut off the crusts and cut into fingers. Lay on a tiered stand.

s.note: the Cornish hotel where the convention meets

Spread the crab over 4 slices, lay thin slices of 1 Lebanese cucumber on top and close with the remaining bread. Press gently, trim off the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers.

m.note: the green soup in the hotel dining room, formula-free
m.how: Sweat 2 sliced leeks and 2 diced potatoes in 40g butter for 10 minutes. Add 1L chicken stock and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in 2 bunches watercress for 1 minute, then blitz until bright green. Finish with 100ml cream.

w.note: the whole cake, in front of everyone
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter. Whisk 4 eggs with 200g sugar and fold in the chocolate, 100g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Cover with 150g chocolate melted with 150ml cream. Serve thin slices.
